description: This is a Java test class for integration testing of loan disbursal undo functionality in the Apache Fineract microfinance platform. It specifically tests scenarios related to undoing loan disbursal operations in various configurations, including down payments, multiple disbursals, manual transactions, and authorization failures.

classes.name: UndoLoanDisbursalWithDownPaymentIntegrationTest
classes.description: A comprehensive JUnit 5 test class for testing the undo disbursal functionality under various loan scenarios including down payments, multiple disbursals, manual transactions, and different configurations of auto-downpayment support.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithSingleDisbursalAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndNoManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo disbursal when a loan with a single disbursal and auto-downpayment enabled is processed without manual transactions.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithSingleDisbursalAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndHasManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo disbursal on a loan with manual transactions after disbursal when auto-downpayment is enabled.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithSingleDisbursalAutoDownPaymentDisabledAndNoManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo disbursal for a loan where auto-downpayment is disabled and no manual transactions are recorded.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithSingleDisbursalAutoDownPaymentDisabledAndHasManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo disbursal for a loan with manual transactions and auto-downpayment disabled.

methods.name: testUndoLastDisbursalForLoanWithSingleDisbursalAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndNoManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undoing the last disbursal in a loan with auto-downpayment enabled and no manual transactions, expecting failure if multiple disbursals are supported.

methods.name: testUndoLastDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndNoManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undoing the last disbursal in a loan with multiple disbursals and auto-downpayment support enabled, expecting failure if more than one disbursal exists.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndNoManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo disbursal for a multi-disbursal loan with auto-downpayment enabled.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndHasManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo disbursal on a multi-disbursal loan with manual transactions recorded.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalAutoDownPaymentDisabledAndNoManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo disbursal for a multi-disbursal loan with auto-downpayment disabled.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalAutoDownPaymentDisabledAndHasManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo disbursal for a multi-disbursal loan with manual transactions when auto-downpayment is disabled.

methods.name: testUndoLastDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalWith2DisburseAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndNoManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undoing the last disbursal when there are two disbursals with auto-downpayment support enabled, expecting failure if extra repayments exist.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalWith2DisburseAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndNoManualTransactionsWithExtraRepayment
methods.description: Tests undo last disbursal with two disbursals and manual transactions, expecting failure due to existing extra repayments.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalWith2DisburseAutoDownPaymentDisabledAndNoManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo last disbursal with multiple disbursals and auto-downpayment disabled, expecting failure if extra repayments exist.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalWith2DisburseAutoDownPaymentDisabledAndHasManualTransactions
methods.description: Tests undo last disbursal in a multi-disbursal loan with manual transactions and no auto-downpayment support.

methods.name: testUndoLastDisbursalForLoanWithMultiDisbursalWith2DisburseAutoDownPaymentEnabledAndNoManualTransactionsWithExtraRepayment
methods.description: Tests undoing the last disbursal with complex disbursal and repayment scenario, expecting failure if extra repayments are present.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursalWithMultipleDisbursalsAndExtraRepayments
methods.description: Tests undo last disbursal with multiple disbursals and manual transactions, expecting failure due to existing extra repayments.

methods.name: testUndoLastDisbursalWithComplexScenarioAndExtraRepayments
methods.description: Tests undoing the last disbursal with complex disbursal and repayment scenario, expecting failure if extra repayments are present.
